hero.name: Raúl Santiago
hero.tagline: I turn data into decisions that move teams forward.

proof.label: Selected Proof
proof.blurb: As a Senior Data Engineer at Devoteam, I design and maintain cloud data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform, helping teams turn raw data into decisions they can trust.

mission.p1: I build the dashboards and pipelines people rely on to make sense of their data: BigQuery pipelines at Devoteam, DBT models and reports at Elastic, and Empire, a data-analysis platform I built for sports and business clients after using it to break down my own tennis matches. I care about the query behind the chart as much as the chart itself.
mission.p2: I have five years of production data engineering experience, most recently as a GCP Data Engineer at Devoteam. Outside that role, I build and ship my own products, including RSNexTech, my personal platform, and Empire, which started as a way to track my own tennis results.
mission.p3: I do my best work when I get to own the messy middle: write the spec, shape the pipeline, and still care about the report a stakeholder actually reads. These days that includes the AI tools I use every day — I use Claude Code and Gemini, then wire their output into the kind of Git and Jira workflow I've written about, so nothing ships without review.

items.title: RSNexTech
items.contentsTagline: PERSONAL PORTFOLIO AND THE ENTRY POINT TO EVERYTHING ELSE
items.quote: A personal portfolio, where my career got its start.
items.description: RSNexTech is the personal site that shows my work and CV in one place — accessible and intuitive, built to introduce me, walk through my projects and career, and give a way into my products and to get in touch.

items.title: Empire Platform
items.contentsTagline: THE CENTRAL GATEWAY TO EVERY SERVICE I BUILD
items.quote: The Empire State Building is the closest thing to heaven in this city.
items.description: Empire Platform is the client-services gateway: a single, centralized connection point to every service I build, so clients never need their own domain and errors and management stay in one place.

items.title: Espíritu Santo Zamora
items.contentsTagline: INFORMATION AND MANAGEMENT FOR THE BROTHERHOOD, IN A NEW LOOK
items.quote: The institutional website of the Hermandad de Semana Santa de Zamora.
items.description: The official site of the Hermandad del Santísimo Cristo del Espíritu Santo de Zamora is now, after two decades, a real information and management hub — connected to databases and registration forms, giving the brotherhood a modernized, new image. V2 is already in the works for 2027.

items.title: Gestión ESZ 2.0
items.contentsTagline: THE BACK OFFICE THAT STREAMLINES THE BROTHERHOOD'S MANAGEMENT
items.quote: The institutional management platform of the Hermandad de Semana Santa de Zamora.
items.description: Alongside the institutional site, this platform manages the brotherhood itself: member records, correspondence, treasury, reports, and analytics — a working app, live today, that speeds up day-to-day management.

items.title: Web 7 Palabras
items.contentsTagline: A SECOND BROTHERHOOD, A RENEWED PRESENCE ONLINE
items.quote: A brotherhood's public face, rebuilt for the web.
items.description: Built on the same foundations as the Espíritu Santo site but shaped to the identity of the Siete Palabras brotherhood: news, activities, and member registration in one place, backed by a database so the brotherhood can publish and respond without relying on third parties.

items.title: Gestión 7 Palabras
items.contentsTagline: MEMBER MANAGEMENT AND CLEAN DATA FOR THE SIETE PALABRAS
items.quote: The management back office for the brotherhood, with its data in order.
items.description: The management counterpart to the Siete Palabras website: member records, correspondence, treasury, and reporting. It adds a data-cleaning layer on top — consolidating and tidying the brotherhood's legacy records so everything the platform shows can be trusted.

items.title: Empire Workspace: Digital Hub for Data Analysis
items.summary: How Empire grew from analyzing my own tennis matches into a data-analysis platform for sports and business clients, built with React, Firebase, and Tableau.

items.title: The Development Power Trio: Integrating Gemini AI with Git and Jira
items.summary: How Gemini AI automates user stories in Jira, reviews code in Git, and writes commit messages — an AI-augmented workflow that speeds up delivery end to end.
